This should have worked on my Kenmore Elite H3.  It fit perfectly, BUT - the screw that goes into the bottom of the unit would NOT snug up the unit tight enough for me to be confident it wouldn't leak.  The holes aligned and everything, but it just wouldn't seal completely, so I returned it.  I'm going to try another brand and see if I have better luck.

Installation was straightforward and worked well on my Whirlpool washer for 15 months before the F02 error again -- failure to drain -- cropped up and, not expecting my new-ish pump to be a problem, took apart the drain line, which was clear, and ultimately returned to the pump to find the fin blade was broken.
Easy to install

I would've given this 5 stars, but I will withhold final judgement for a couple of years. That's because I replaced this part a couple of years ago once already. The first pump (different manufacturer) worked well for only a couple of years...until it didn't. So we're hoping this one lasts longer. They're VERY easy to replace and not expensive, so I'm not overly upset that we got a couple of years out of the first one, but it is inconvenient when they go out. If you've never done it before, you can easily find YouTube videos online for this repair.

This is my 3rd pump, they go just about 1 year without fail.  Now when I notice the laundry coming out wet even after extended spin I just order another one.  Easy to replace, I'm a pro now, but still an annual event these days!

Cheaply made, broke again within 4.5 months. Buying another. It would be nice if somebody made one with metal fins that didn’t snap so easily if something makes its way into the drain (coins, hair pins, etc.)

I first replaced the pump in my Kenmore HE3 in August 2020 and like a few others, the impeller in the new pump eventually broke off, in my case in June 2022. It came with a lifetime warranty, and although Amazon has the wrong company contact information and thus it isn't as easy as it should be to get warranty service, the warranty is perfectly fine. Ignore the post that says it's a scam--it's not. Contact BlueStars via the "ask the seller a question" link on thjeir store page and they honor the warranty, quickly and with no hassle. If you're handy, replacement takes only a few minutes (advice: a bunch of water isn't pumped out the washer when the pump fails, so use a shop vac to suck up the water when you open the trap to prevent a mini-flood!).
Only lasted a little over a month
Bought the first one in 2021. It was replaced after it started making a loud, grinding noise and quit pumping drain water. Replacement is working fine.
Did not clear the error on my machine. Had to replace with higher quality piece.
The mount was different than the original but the pump part was exchangeable with the original. Works great!
Super easy to install, worked great.  Old pump had broken impeller, this one seems to be more robust, so hopefully will work well over time.

Pump failed at the brass motor shaft!! This is purely cheap material. I would expect the plastic to fail over time , but not the shaft. This is advertised as the New upgraded model. Very disappointed.

This cheap little motor saved me at least $1000 by not having to buy a new washer.  I think I was 5 years into my Maytag Maxima front loader.  Thanks to covid, no parts anywhere.  Possibly stopped making them?  Not sure, kept getting the run-around from the local dealer.  This part went in easily, fit perfect.  Only issue was trying to guess which wire went where because that was slightly different from the stock, but I must have guessed right because it has been running for a couple months now without issue.  I went ahead and bought a 2nd motor to keep on standby in case this one eventually fails.
It's different looking but exact replacement. Working fine so far,,!!!

I’m glad I took a chance and replace this part instead of buying a new set, it literally took maybe a minute to install after the 5 to 10 of getting the screws out. Once again I started a load of laundry and everything worked great!

I was told 17 years ago that I shouldn't expect my new washer to last longer than about 10 years. With a good screwdriver, youtube videos, and proper maintenance here we are. I had to replace the water pump because a damn face mask got out of its mesh bag and sucked through the trap all the way into the pump and killed it. This pump was about 6 times cheaper than a "factory part". There are some differences and it's a bit louder, but it does the job. Easy enough to install that this untrained stay at home mom can do it. Bonus: I'm pretty darn proud of myself for saving the money I would have wasted to have a repair person tell me they can't get the part for 2 weeks and it's gonna cost me half the price of a new washer to install.

Easy, perfect replacement for my 2006 Kenmore front-loading washer; arrived yesterday, replaced today, so no comment on longevity.

Amazon picture showed 3 screws, but none were included. I was happy to use the three old screws.

Washer was intermittently not draining at all, or draining incompletely. I wasn't positive it was the pump, because sometimes it worked.

It WAS the pump. Four loads done now, no error codes and excellent draining.

$20 and a little effort vs an expensive repairman, trip charge, or worse yet a new machine... I couldn't be happier.
Bought this pump in September of 2021 and had to replace in November of 2022.  Motor began making horrible noise and grew very hot.  Buy better quality to avoid the hassle of replacement.

I only just installed it because of the F02 error from the last pump. This pump is a perfect fit, comes with 2 extra O-rings, and operates quietly. The Replacement pump sells for $150 from retail stores so this is a great buy. For the 20 minutes it has run so far, it has cleared the F02 error and I am very happy with it. I will come back and update should it ever stop working. Assume if there is no update that it is still being used daily (2 adults, 4 kids, washable diapers and all our clothes on top of that daily use).

4/10/2023 update. Used once every day or more and still working just as quiet as when installed.

I got this product thinking it will have a lifetime warranty, and it did work for awhile. However this product broke shortly after purchasing and installing it. I then tried to contact the company they have listed for warranty issues and it turns out they used a different company website and phone number that has NOTHING to do with the company who sold the item. The warranty is bogus! There is no one to contact to get a replacement. Yes it is cheap, yes it will break quickly.
I did reach out to Amazon and they said they would do an internal investigation on this issue.

One video shows how to open up your dryer to replace the switch, another shows how to bypass the door switch completely. I bypassed the switch so I could use the dryer until this little unit arrived. I've had my Inglis by Whirlpool dryer since 2007 and when it stopped working I was worried...who wants to spend money on a new dryer when the current dryer simply needs a new part?!...NOT ME! I used trial and error when trying to find the issue. First replacing the fuse which didnt work. Then purchasing this door switch and the thermostat. The door switch was pretty easy to change out and fixed the problem! I left the new fuse and am saving the thermostat just in case it needs changing down the line (all of which are products of Blue Stars) and in total came out to less than $30 for all 3 parts. I'm so glad our dryer was fixed with minimal spending and about 45 minutes after work on a Friday! I'd definitely purchase from Blue Stars again if need be.
